title: 美联储官员穆萨勒姆：六到九个月或需收紧，通胀目标还能回2%吗
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's start with the elephant in the room anytime you talk to the fed person is obviously what is your view of the state of inflation now and what the fed has to do with it?
segments.zh: 每次和美联储的人交谈，绕不开的话题就是：你怎么看当前通胀状态，美联储该怎么做？

segments.en: So in my view, inflation is elevated. It's above target. It's being driven by persistent
segments.zh: 在我看来，通胀偏高，高于目标，由持续的需求压力和反复的负面供给冲击推动。

segments.en: demand pressures and recurring negative supply shocks. The important thing at this point in
segments.zh: 当前重要的是及时将通胀拉回2%附近。

segments.en: time is to bring inflation back towards 2% on a timely manner and at this point in time it's
segments.zh: 同时要遏制通胀压力进一步扩散，或负面供给冲击和持续需求压力可能引发的第二轮效应。

segments.en: important to contain any further broadening of inflation pressures or any second round effects which could be coming from the negative supply shocks or the persistent demand pressures.
segments.zh: 你说及时，那及时是什么意思？通常我考虑货币政策时，会想利率路径应该怎样，我还没确定。

segments.en: Well you say in a timely fashion what does timely mean? So typically when I think about monetary policy what I'm thinking about what the path of rights ought to be I haven't mined
segments.zh: 大概一年半到两年，差不多18个月左右。那这是否意味着，用你同事的话说，我们不必急于加息，你会给什么时间框架？

segments.en: somewhere between a year and a half and two years something like that so 18 months are there abouts. So does that mean that well let's put it in terms of your colleagues who have said
segments.zh: 大约一年半到两年，差不多18个月左右。那么这是否意味着，我们来看看你同事们所说的

segments.en: we don't have to be in a rush to raise interest rates what kind of time frame would you put on it?
segments.zh: 我们不必急于加息，你认为时间框架是怎样的？
